name: Carley
feeding: Needs to be fed twice a day
walks: Good adventure each morning, then fine for 6+ hours — as long as she is not shut in a kennel
alert: Hates being left alone — will howl for her people (not destructive). Owner brings her crate as a safe space. Wary of cats; may freeze if one is aggressive.

name: Jake
tags: Friendly with dogs, cats and kids
feeding: Needs to be fed twice a day
walks: Potty break every 4 hours; can be left alone 1–4 hours

name: Hazel
feeding: Needs to be fed 3 times a day (1/2 cup prescribed dry food) — morning, 4–5 PM, and 7–8 PM. Owner sends her own food.
walks: Potty break every 4 hours; can be left alone 1–4 hours
alert: Special prescription diet to prevent bladder stones — her food only. Occasional morning nausea; the evening feeding usually prevents it. Unsure with cats.
